title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Mix sugar, all-purpose flour, onion soup mix, salt, and ground black pepper in a small bowl. Set aside.
In a large pot, melt butter. Add onions and caramelize about 25 minutes on low heat, mixing occasionally.
Add the flour mixture to onions and stir to create a roux. Slowly add water to roux, and continue mixing.
Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 30 to 40 minutes.
Preheat oven to broil. Ladle soup into 6 oven-safe bowls. Float a baguette slice on top of each soup. Sprinkle about 2 tablespoons of shredded mozzarella cheese onto the bread slices.
Place filled bowls onto a cookie sheet. Place cookie sheet in oven under broiler. Broil 4 minutes. Serve immediately.

tips.title: Garlic Baguette
tips.text: For a garlic bread topper instead of a plain baguette slice: slice 1 French-style baguette on a diagonal about 1-inch thick and place on a cookie sheet lined with baking paper. Brush each slice with 1/4 cup (1/2 stick) melted butter, sprinkle with 2 cloves garlic (minced), and bake at 400°F for 10 minutes.

notes: This soup was served to my seminary students at the weekly class I hosted. It became an instant favorite and to my chagrin — a weekly request! No getting away with microwave popcorn and carrot sticks for me, like my fellow teachers.
